name: Projected Terminal Paste Review Dialog
description: Reviews suspicious terminal paste text before one attachment can publish its sanitized semantic input.

states: Inspect the localized warnings and control-visible original preview for replaced controls and an embedded bracketed-paste terminator.
Cancel with Escape or the visible action, then approve with Paste; each path settles the pending attachment decision once.

useWhen: One projected terminal attachment must review multiline or control-bearing paste text before semantic input publication.
avoidWhen: The inspected paste is safe without review, or another product workflow owns a non-terminal confirmation.
invariants: The preview is bounded, displays unsafe control code points visibly, and derives from the retained original text rather than sanitized output.
Cancel, lifecycle abort, and approval settle the pending attachment decision at most once and never bypass FIFO input ordering.
Approval publishes only sanitized text with the reviewed bracketed-paste mode; the Host rejects a changed authoritative mode before admission.
